$note: The WHOLE thing you write — a recursive decision tree over one `fact`. A NODE tests a `field`; each `branches` entry {op,value,then} is a path (first match wins); `then` is either action leaves [{set,value}] or a nested node. Column/value types are derived from the declared `fact`. fromEngineProject generates the Business Central .gdt XML (best-effort — well-formed, BC-load not verified). The runtime evaluator (functions/decision-tree.mjs) executes this tree directly. Since a tree compiles to DRL, the executable path is also a DRL ruleset (../drl). See scenarios.md §0.
